title: Wake the pendulum
description: A steel ball hangs in the air at (40, 270), top left, and falls from the start. A steel pendulum weight 5 cm in radius hangs at rest at (200, 160) on a 100 cm rod from a pin at (200, 260). A wood ball rests at (160, 159) on a fixed ledge that runs level from x = 150 to 170 with its top at y = 153, so the upper half of the ball stands in the path of the swinging weight. A fixed post runs level from x = 90 to 120 with its top at y = 102. A bell hangs at (35, 50), bottom left, from a bracket 20 cm above it. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 10 to 290. Something moving has to touch the pendulum weight (pend), then the wood ball (ball1), then the post, in that order, before anything rings the bell. Chain length is scored too.
